messages:
sam: Heads-up — seeing gaps in token accounting after soft reconnects on streaming sessions. Customer reports provisional charges that later disappear. Anyone else seeing this?

maya: Yup, hit this with mobile client flaky network. Reconnects show provisional tokens in console, then final ledger removes ~20% of them.

ben: I traced one: reconnect flow generates a new ephemeral session id, server treats it as a fresh prefix so we emit provisional charge for resumed tokens, then background dedupe removes duplicates when final ack arrives.

infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2026. Relevant trace id listed in ticket.

sam: Paste of log snippet: ```
INFO reconnect session resume_id=sr_93a prefix_len=128 provisional_charge=94
DEBUG reconnect routed_to host=gpu-12 zone=us-west-2 affinity=none
WARN final ack merged: removed provisional tokens=18
```

maya: That warning matches what we saw. UX problem: console shows provisional tokens in quota meter which confuses SREs and customers.

ben: Root cause options: 1) preserve strong affinity on reconnect so resume goes to same host and reuses prefix snapshot, 2) emit provisional with a resume_id tag so we can attribute & reconcile deterministically, 3) change console/telemetry to show provisional vs confirmed.

sam: Tradeoffs: strong affinity reduces router flexibility and could cause hotspots. We should prefer option 2+3 as lower-risk.

maya: For telemetry we need minimal perf hit. Proposal: add two tags to billing events: charge_state=(provisional|confirmed) and resume_hint=(true|false). Sample rate for provisional events can be 1% for high-volume customers.

ben: Agreed. Also suggest we add resume_id to the billing event payload so reconciliation is O(1) during ledger merge. Current ledger uses session_id only which is ambiguous across reconnects.

sam: Console UX: add a small toggle in the route-level quota panel: "Show provisional charges" (off by default) with tooltip: "Provisional = counted until final ack; may be de-duplicated." That should stop panicked escalations.

maya: Can we also surface a timeline per session showing reconnects, resume_id churn, provisional vs confirmed? Even a sampled view would help ops.

ben: Implementation plan: backend events change + ledger reconciliation change (safe backwards compatible): 1) add resume_id to billing events, 2) emit charge_state, 3) reconciliation job uses resume_id to mark final state and compact provisional entries. I'll draft an RFC.

sam: Who owns rollout? We need a canary set and a console flag. Also alerts to detect regressions (provisional spike > 1% of tokens). @ben can you own RFC + rollout plan?

ben: Yep, I'll take RFC. Target draft by EOD Fri.

maya: I'll pull 3 customer traces and add to INC-2026. Also will mock console wire for PM review.

sam: Quick question for infra — do we need any router change for this interim?

ben: For interim, no router change required. Long-term we might add soft-affinity: prefer previous host for N secs. That will be separate RFC.

infra-bot: Reaction: :thumbsup: from ops.

sam: OK let's sync Tue 10am to review RFC + sample traces. Thanks all.
